settings.q: Can you build a specific character's weapon?
settings.a: Yes - send reference images and we'll sculpt and finish it. Original designs are welcome too.

settings.q: Is it light enough to carry at a convention?
settings.a: Yes, we build props to be lightweight, comfortable to hold and convention-friendly.

settings.q: Can I choose the size and finish?
settings.a: Yes - scale, colours and weathering are all customisable.
Yes, we ship worldwide from Dubai, packed to protect the prop.

settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A large, screen-accurate chainsaw man cosplay prop, sculpted and finished for conventions, photoshoots and display. Built lightweight and handle-ready, it makes an instant statement for cosplayers and collectors of anime-style weapon props.
settings.desc_title: Want to Carry The Power of
settings.s1_body: This oversized chainsaw man prop is built for impact - sculpted in detail, painted and weathered for a screen-accurate look, and made light enough to carry all day at a convention. Whether you want a recreation of a favourite anime weapon or your own design, we model it, build it and finish it as a display-worthy, photo-ready prop.
settings.case_heading: A Prop That Commands the Room
settings.case_body: Built as a hero cosplay prop, this chainsaw man prop was designed to read from across a convention floor and hold up to close-up photos - detailed, weathered and lightweight enough to wield comfortably all day.
settings.case_quote: Got stopped for photos all weekend. Looks brutal up close and it's so light to carry.
settings.prov_p: Denji is the hero of Chainsaw man anime. He was fused with his demon that gave him the power of chainsaw whenever he pulled the lever.
